draft.summary: A basement refresh: paint the block walls or frame false walls in front of them, new floor, maybe the ceiling.
draft.scopeOfWork: Refresh the finished basement: prepare and paint the walls (or frame, insulate, drywall and paint false walls in front of the block), new flooring throughout, ceiling paint if the customer wants it. Existing fixtures stay. Customer clears the room before work starts.
